simple_explanation: 'Our School — A Happy Place' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: Green School Aasha and Mohit were walking to school together.
Mohit smiled happily and said, “I love school!
It is where I see my friends, play games and learn new things every day.
Our school is a place where we feel safe, and cared for.
Asha said, “My school teaches us how to care for plants, trees and animals.
